primary_budget: 64 uncached complete synthetic oracle calls, including common initialization
other_caps: 60 seconds and 128 MILP calls; 256 route/candidate evaluations is a loop guard, not an equivalent unit of work across methods
initialization: the existing four exact charged routes; identical observations and cache available to all methods
target_definition: initial best U + 0.005; fixed before new runs, no success-conditioned mean
schedule: seeded shuffle of all 24 runs on the same CPU process, BLAS threads fixed to one
evidence: existing manufactured convex queue-cost benchmark; not actual FIFO replay, hardware or a validated server deployment workload
reference: reuse sealed continuous reference intervals for reporting/audit only; never available to search
adaptation: facility local-search and block-alternation mechanisms, plus continuous DE with explicit mixed-domain decoding; not reproductions of original systems or their approximation/convergence guarantees
stop_rule: one fixed batch, retain losses/failures and do not tune, add seeds, expand load or retry for performance
